conclusions.cpu: Fixed synthetic-correction profiling:84.55ms to21.84ms,3.87x speedup;48/48 same choices;actual trained-student prediction error<=2e-6.
conclusions.heldout: Fast51.5ms vs original PUCT31 67.2ms,but15 vs6 blunders. Matched-batch PUCT31 is45.6ms with7 blunders. Same-budget superiority not achieved.
conclusions.direct_games: 192 complete games,no truncation. Stable original-budget agent scores7W5D20L vs PUCT31 and0W7D25L vs PUCT512;conditional relative Elo about-150 and-364.
conclusions.adoption: Retain kernel implementation speedup; do not promote reduced-search configuration as a strength improvement. PUCT remains unchanged.

kernel.note: Synthetic fixed corrections; CPU timings exclude GPU and are not an end-to-end strength claim. Float summation order changes; separate heldout quality and direct games used.

initial.development: First32 roots of prior correction-safety run; explicitly reused for development, never final holdout.
initial.selection: Among non-PUCT variants with development median_seconds <=1.10*PUCT31 median and neural cap32, choose fewest>=100cp losses, then lowest mean CP regret. If none, record unmet speed goal and choose best regret.
initial.final_holdout: 96 fresh roots after independently frozen32 game openings; no tuning on final outcomes
initial.matches: Direct swapped-color games,32 opening pairs per opponent:64 vsPUCT31 and64 vsoriginalPUCT512; relative scores and paired uncertainty, no absolute Elo.
